desc:
A modern and comfortable 10-year new 2-bedroom condo suite with 1 bathroom and 2 underground parking stalls at the 3rd Floor of Elgin House in prestigious Harvard Gardens community is built by Polygon Homes Real Estates Ltd. at the corner of 152nd Street and 33rd Avenue in South Surrey. This condo unit is facing EAST toward 152nd Street.

Laminated floor throughout, carpeted bedrooms, in-suite washer and dryer, nice patio to enjoy a cup of coffee and play with your smartphone. Spacious walk-in closet at the master bedroom.

Transit stops within walking distance to King George Skytrain Station, Guildford Town Centre and Richmond-Brighouse of Canada Line. The Keg Steakhouse, Suds City Car Wash and Jiffy Lube Engine Oil Change are just right across the street. Sungiven Food, Save-On-Food Grocery store, Canadian Tire store, Tim Horton’s, Starbucks Cafe, Milestone Restaurant, Wendy's and Edo Japanese Restaurant, Payless Shoes and Staples office supplies at the South Point Exchange Mall are only one block away.

Enjoy a leisure stroll after dinner inside the Harvard Gardens community. Host a few friends during weekend in the elegant Rowing Club House. The phenomenal Rowing Club House for the Harvard Gardens community offers an indoor basketball court, a game room with ping-pong table, a media room for movie previews, a neat beverage kitchen and a billiard table for entertaining your friends, a standard sized heated outdoor swimming pool and a sauna pool, two 1-bedroom guest suites with washer and dryer in a laundry room on the same floor (2rd floor at the Rowing Club House) to host your in-laws and a fitness room to get your daily exercise (30+ minutes/day) done. On-site Managers (Caretakers) for Rowing Clubhouse and Elgin House building.

This comfortable 10-year new two-bedroom condo unit is suitable for a single person with professional career or a legally married couple without child or with only one child. Everything is conveniently located here so you can enjoy the peaceful and beautiful living space and vibrant neighborhood within this prestigious community while building up delightful memories that will last a lifetime. 

The monthly rent is $2,600/month with Hydro bill the tenant's responsibility ($60 - $80/month depending on usage) with one underground parking stall included in the monthly rent. Another underground parking stall is available for additional $100/month parking rent. This fascinating condo suite is available on August 1, 2026. Yearly lease only.

Application Criteria:
1. Personal or combined family gross income exceeds $96,000/year (or $8,000/month). Proof of income is required. Must have been with the current employer for 2 years or more. Must consent to credit check. Reference check with current employer and landlord.

2. Must be non-smokers. No drugs (neither cannabis, crack cocaine, heroin, crystal meth nor Fentanyl) is allowed. NO pot parties. No excessive drinking of alcoholic beverage. Diligent, disciplined and productive people with humble attitude to obey all the Strata by-laws and stable employment income as well as healthy and discreet lifestyle preferred.

3. NO PET of any sort. (NO Dog, NO Cat, No fish tank. NO Exception.)
If it is found later that the tenants keep pets without landlord's consent, it is sufficient ground for eviction. By the way, I have excellent relationship with the neighbors. I own and manage multiple residential rental properties. For the last 21 years, I just had to evict tenants only ONCE due to pet violation, so that people know that I actually mean what I say. 

Do you have unlimited time LIVING on earth? Nobody does. You can only live ONCE. There are so many blessings in this world that money can NOT buy. For everything else, you can come back to your sweet home. Since you can not park your car into a mutual fund, nor can you rest your tired head on a stock certificate or enjoy a cup of cappuccino on an insurance policy. Your HOME is where beautiful memory is made. Don't forget to cherish that.

As you marvel at the gorgeous Sunrise and colorful Sunset, beautiful rainbow after rain, look out to the vista of snow-capped mountain on Sunday afternoon from your patio and feel the breeze pass through your hair, you can feel the beauty of life and let that pleasure engraved in your mind. Mesmerizing experience you will remember for a life time.

This comfortable 2-bedroom condo is for humble, hard-working, disciplined and productive people who appreciate the daily essence of life - that means finding something you truly LOVE and then making that daily experience worthwhile.

This is, honestly, a beautiful place to live. Those people who meet all the application criteria and have strong employment record and decent employment income as well as good landlord references and discreet lifestyle are welcome to apply.

How much does the quality of your life WORTH? Make the efforts to find JOY in life. You won't regret it. Trust me on this.

E-mail communication only during the screening process. Viewing is available ONLY to QUALIFIED prospective tenants by appointment. - Rose

By the way, for those people who feel cynical about the Application Criteria while lacking humility and obedience, I would appreciate that you keep your opinion (/preferences) to yourself and look elsewhere for your housing needs. I am looking for like-minded people who are INSPIRED to live a productive and meaningful life. Thank you.
